ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE load_list IS

 v_rg_id RECORDGROUP;
 F VARCHAR2(7);
 T VARCHAR2(11);
 BEGIN
 
 v_rg_id :=FIND_GROUP('DCLN_STA');
 if id_null(v_rg_id) then
 
 v_rg_id := create_GROUP_FROM_QUERY('DCLN_STA',
 'SELECT DISTINCT min( '' ''||DCLTN_STA_DESC),TO_CHAR(DCLTN_STA_CD) 
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE (DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0) OR 
 (DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=1) 
 group by DCLTN_STA_CD ORDER BY 2');
 
 END if;
 if populate_group(v_rg_id) = 0 then
 populate_list('P_DCLTN_STA',v_rg_id);

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VAL IS
pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5); 
 X NUMBER (7);
 Y NUMBER (7);
 V_SELECT NUMBER (2);
 P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN 
 IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :P_PORT_CD ;
 END IF;
 
IF :P_GRP_ID IS NULL THEN
GO_ITEM('P_GRP_ID');
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,180,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
IF :START_DT IS NULL THEN
GO_ITEM('START_DT');
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,110,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF :TYPE_REPORT = 1 THEN
 V_SELECT :=1;
ELSE
 V_SELECT :=2;
END IF;


SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
SELECT DCLTN_NBR
FROM
DCLTN_GRPS L_DG,
DECLARATIONS DCLTN
WHERE
DCLTN.PORT_CD = L_DG.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN.GROUP_ID = L_DG.GRP_ID 
AND (L_DG.GRP_ID = :P_GRP_ID )
AND (DCLTN.INSPTR_ID = :P_INSPTR_ID OR :P_INSPTR_ID IS NULL)
AND (DCLTN.DCLTN_DT BETWEEN (:START_DT) AND (:END_DT))

AND (
 (
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0) 
 AND((DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (9,11,12,14)AND :SELECT1=2 )OR(:SELECT1<>2) )
 )
 OR 
 (
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=1 ) 
 AND((DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (5,9)AND :SELECT1=2 )OR(:SELECT1<>2) )
 )
 )

AND ((DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=:P_DCLTN_STA AND :SELECT1=3) OR :SELECT1<>3 ) 
AND ((DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :CHECK2 = 1 )OR :CHECK2=0)
)
;
 

IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_dec_ISN',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.TRAN_SELECT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_GRP_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_GRP_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_INSPTR_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_INSPTR_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_SELECT',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SELECT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CHECK2',TEXT_PARAMETER,:CHECK2);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'SELECT1',TEXT_PARAMETER,:SELECT1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_STA',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_STA);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_ORDER',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.V_ORDER);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 


ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END ;
